exposed_crystal_plane_indices.Ru-Re/Al2O3: RuO2 particles 20 nm in size, Re species not visible

Proof in the paper: The Ru species was present as RuO2 particles 20 nm in size as determined by the Scherrer equation, and Re species were not visible (Figure 1a). A HAADF-STEM measurement with EDX analysis displayed that Re species were highly dispersed with an average size of 0.5 nm (Figure 1c; more details are given in Figure S4a–c).
